source_kind: hand-built from company site icon (512 px), with the pin and disc paths from its favicon.svg
edits: built by hand from exact geometry fitted to the official raster (hand_constructed; construction and measures below)
viewBox cropped to the drawing (2% pad)

hand.construction: the pin and its white disc are PostalDataPI's own paths from favicon.svg (the mark it serves as its favicon), placed by one fitted scale and offset; favicon.svg sets the "i" as live text in the viewer's sans-serif, so the "i" is built here, a rectangle and a rounded dot fitted to the 512 px icon; the "POSTAL DATA" lettering under the pin in that icon is not part of the favicon's mark and is left out
hand.verification: every measure at the source's own resolution: silhouette IoU, boundary F within 1 source px, the largest boundary distance in source px, the share of the interior more than CIEDE2000 3 off, SSIM at 22/48/96 px on the app's four tiles, fills sampled from the source; then the SVG drawn at 384 px and inspected for wobbles
